name: Call of Fire
summary: Atop Durotar's peaks, a shaman faces the trial that attunes them to fire. Telf Joolam guides the initiate to drink fire sapta, confront a Minor Manifestation of Fire, and claim its glowing ember to light the ceremonial torch.

sections.title: Eyes of the Flame
sections.body: Fire spirits hide from untrained eyes on Durotar's summit. To see them, you drink fire sapta, a draught made from reagents gathered across the barrens and coast. It sharpens your senses to the unseen, revealing minor spirits and manifestations among the summit crags.

sections.title: Confronting the Manifestation
sections.body: A Minor Manifestation of Fire waits atop the mountain. Once the sapta takes hold, the spirit knows you can see it and awaits your challenge. Fire answers strength and decisive action, so you strike without delay. The longer the fight lasts, the more fiercely the elemental fire burns.

sections.title: The Brazier of the Dormant Flame
sections.body: After the manifestation falls, you claim its lingering heat as a glowing ember. At the summit shrine, you place the ember in the Brazier of the Dormant Flame. The inscribed metal stays cool beneath Durotar's sun and winds until the ember meets the bowl. Then a white-hot blaze kindles the ritual torch.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this trial?
faq.answer: You prove your strength by facing a manifestation of fire and capturing its heat in a ritual torch. The trial earns you the right to fashion a Fire Totem.

faq.q: Why do I need to drink the fire sapta?
faq.answer: You drink fire sapta to see and touch the fire elementals gathered atop the mountain, normally beyond mortal sight.

faq.q: Where is the Minor Manifestation of Fire found?
faq.answer: The Minor Manifestation of Fire waits at the mountain ridge's highest peak above Telf Joolam's perch in Durotar, near the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
Telf Joolam is an eccentric shaman hermit who lives high on a rocky ridge in Durotar. He guides young Horde initiates through dangerous, temperamental rites to understand fire.

faq.q: Why does the manifestation grow stronger during the fight?
aliases: why is the fire elemental so strong
faq.answer: Fire gathers strength and burns hotter as time passes. You strike decisively, since hesitation lets the spirit grow stronger.

faq.q: What happens after the brazier is lit?
faq.answer: Lighting the brazier kindles the ceremonial torch. You carry its sacred flame down the mountain to complete your Fire Totem.

angles.text: As a shaman, you learn that fire is volatile and destructive, unlike solid, unyielding earth. It consumes an indecisive caller, so you need focus and authority to master it.
As a Horde shaman, you join orc and troll shamans who climb Durotar's red crags to prove their communion with the land's fiery spirits.
